rows.label: qst200214_msg0001
rows.name: Tuvarri-san. We talked to Jaruru, and[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200214_msg0002
rows.name:
Ah, are you Jaruru's
messengers? Just perfect!

rows.label: qst200214_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm short on cargo and in a bind.
Could you hurry and pick it up for me?

rows.label: qst200214_msg0004
rows.name:
Uoooooh! Like I'd ever help
with smuggling[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200214_msg0006
rows.name:
What, Nia? I'm trying to make this guy
see the error of his ways[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200214_msg0007
rows.name:
Guren, maybe Tuvarri-san isn't tied to
the smuggling?

rows.label: qst200214_msg0009
rows.name:
He'd mix it with other cargo, right?
Wouldn't it be better to cooperate
and find out the destination?

rows.label: qst200214_msg0011
rows.name:
Tuvarri-san, leave the cargo
collection to us. But, could you
tell us what we should bring?

rows.label: qst200214_msg0012
rows.name:
Ah[ML:Dash ] We're short two Divine Beast
Craniums and five Ancient Chalices.

rows.label: qst200214_msg0013
rows.name:
If you don't have them on hand,
I think you can get them by
Salvaging, so hurry up, please!

rows.label: qst200214_msg0014
rows.name:
Uoooooooh!! Somehow this
doesn't sit right with me!!

rows.label: qst200214_msg0015
rows.name:
Wh-what!? Why did you suddenly
start yelling?!

rows.label: qst200214_msg0016
rows.name: No, nothing! Well then, we're off!
